title: Task 2.1: Buying Products Based on Others' Trends vs Personal Needs
content:
Read the following statement:

"In modern consumer society, many people tend to purchase goods and follow trends simply because others around them are doing so, while others argue that consumers should only buy what genuinely suits their personal needs and financial situation."

Discuss both views and give your own opinion in an essay to an educated reader. Include relevant examples and explanations to support your view.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was unsure which running shoes to buy when he joined a new jogging club. Therefore, he decided to buy the popular model that most of his teammates were wearing. As a result, he finally felt comfortable fitting in with the group and enjoyed reliable shoe quality during weekend runs. If he had not followed that trend, he would not have been able to pick a good pair so quickly.
body1.focus: Quan điểm 1: Mua theo xu hướng (Hòa nhập nhóm bạn và chọn nhanh nhờ đánh giá chung)
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, people should recognize why some support buying popular trendy products | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, this perspective has reasonable points.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that following popular trends helps people feel stylish and fit in with friends and social groups. This means that wearing fashionable clothes or using trending gadgets gives some buyers confidence in social settings. Another point I would like to make is that widely popular items often come with many user reviews online. This is because of the fact that seeing others enjoy a product makes shoppers feel safer about trying something new.

body2.example: For example, I was often tempted to buy trendy clothes I saw on TikTok and ran out of savings before the end of the month. For this reason, I got to write a clear shopping list based on my actual needs and monthly budget before buying anything. If I had not changed my shopping habit, I would not have been able to know how peaceful it feels to keep steady savings.
body2.focus: Quan điểm 2 (Ủng hộ): Mua theo nhu cầu thực tế và khả năng tài chính (Mini-essay #3 + Câu #10 + Cụm #21 & #24)
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, there are stronger arguments in support of buying only what suits personal needs and financial limits | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that buying based on personal needs is a more practical choice.
body2.point: In fact, choosing products based on real needs allows purchases to fit comfortably within our budget and daily routine without sacrificing quality. This happens because when consumers chase social media trends out of peer pressure, it easily leads to wasting money on cheap or useless items and falling into debt. In addition, planning purchases calmly helps families stay on the safe side and save money for truly important goals.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, although both views have reasonable points, I prefer buying products based on personal needs because it allows people to save money and brings long-term financial peace of mind. Therefore, both individuals and families should work together to make the most of smart shopping habits responsibly.

Therefore, he decided to follow our parents' plan to tidy his own room and prepare simple breakfasts on weekends. As a result, he finally became much more confident, organized, and responsible at school. Another point I would like to make is that completing small duties alone builds strong self-confidence and responsibility. This is because of the fact that children feel proud when they can take care of themselves without always waiting for adults.

body2.example: For example, I was nervous when I moved away from my hometown to study at university in a big city. This is because of the fact that people often leave taps running, ignore leaking pipes, and overuse water without thinking about future shortages.

title: Task 2.6: Discussing the Growing Popularity of Online Shopping
content:
Read the following statement:

"E-commerce and online shopping have grown exponentially in recent years, with an increasing number of consumers preferring to purchase goods via the internet rather than visiting physical brick-and-mortar stores."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the reasons why online shopping has become so popular, and discuss whether this trend brings more advantages or disadvantages to society. Include relevant examples and explanations to support your view.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was working overtime every day and had no time to visit crowded shopping malls. Therefore, he decided to order his office shirts and household supplies on a trusted e-commerce app. As a result, he finally saved hours each weekend and paid much less thanks to online vouchers. If he had not tried online shopping, he would not have been able to manage his busy schedule so smoothly.
body1.focus: Lý do phổ biến & Ưu điểm: Nhanh chóng, tiện lợi và dễ so sánh giá (Cụm #18 + #21)
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, online shopping brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make online shopping appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that online shopping is fast and convenient for busy people in modern-day society. This means that workers and students can order clothes, books, and daily goods in a few minutes from home without spending hours in heavy traffic. Another point I would like to make is that e-commerce platforms make it easy to compare prices and find good discounts. This is because of the fact that shoppers can view hundreds of stores on one screen and pick items that fit comfortably within their budget.

body2.example: For example, I was excited to order a discounted winter jacket online last month after seeing bright product photos. For this reason, I got to receive a thin, poorly made coat in the wrong size and wasted both money and time returning it. If I had not experienced that disappointing order, I would not have been able to know how important it is to check trusted sellers carefully.
body2.focus: Nhược điểm: Lãng phí tiền, hàng kém chất lượng và rủi ro thông tin cá nhân (Câu #10 & #11)
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of online shopping are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that poor-quality items and online risks can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, shopping on e-commerce apps often tempts buyers to waste money on cheap items that look nothing like the advertised photos. This happens because when customers cannot touch or try products before paying, it easily leads to receiving wrong sizes, thin fabric, and troublesome returns. In addition, sharing personal or payment details on unsafe websites puts buyers at risk of losing money and personal privacy.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, online shopping brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from saving time, easy price comparisons, and home delivery, they also need to handle poor-quality goods and online shopping risks. Therefore, both individuals and tech companies should work together to make the most of online shopping responsibly.

title: Task 2.9: Young People Replacing Traditional Activities with Digital Devices
content:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, an increasing number of young people spend most of their leisure time using electronic devices and modern technology rather than engaging in traditional activities, such as reading printed books or playing outdoors."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the causes of this trend and proposing practical solutions to encourage youth to maintain a healthy balance. Provide reasons and specific examples from your knowledge or experience to support your answer.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was an active boy who used to play football outside with neighbors every afternoon. Therefore, when our parents became busy with late work shifts, he decided to stay in his room watching TikTok and playing mobile games instead. As a result, he finally lost interest in outdoor sports and spent nearly four hours a day on screens. If he had not been left without daily family guidance, he would not have been so attached to his phone.
body1.focus: Nguyên nhân: Cha mẹ bận rộn thiếu định hướng và ứng dụng giải trí quá thu hút (Mini-essay #2 & #3)
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, there are several major causes leading to young people replacing traditional activities with electronic devices | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these are the key causes of young people replacing traditional activities with electronic devices.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that many parents work long hours and fail to spend enough time talking with or guiding their children. This means that teenagers lack proper guidance and self-control, so they easily turn to smartphones and laptops for quick company. Another point I would like to make is that social media apps and online games are designed to be fast, colorful, and hard to put down. This is because of the fact that scrolling through short videos feels much easier and more immediately exciting than reading printed books or playing outdoors.

body2.example: For example, my high school launched weekend badminton and book-sharing clubs while parents agreed to keep dinner time phone-free, which quickly encouraged students to enjoy outdoor games and printed books again.
body2.focus: Giải pháp thực tế: Cá nhân giới hạn giờ dùng máy + Gia đình & Nhà trường tổ chức hoạt động + Giáo dục (Ruột Solutions)

In addition, schools and families need to organize fun sports clubs, create cozy reading spaces, and spend quality screen-free time together. Above all, education plays a key role in tackling this issue, because young people need to be aware of its impacts on their eyes and health so that they can act responsibly.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, young people replacing traditional activities with digital devices is closely linked to busy family lifestyles and attractive digital apps and requires practical steps such as personal screen limits and engaging offline activities. Therefore, both schools and families need to take steady, practical actions to reduce this problem in the long run.
